service); with a session only `phone` is used, to fill an empty `users.phone` (D33).

DeclineRequest.title: DeclineRequest

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

EstimateEditRead.description:
`PUT …/estimate` response (spec 03 §5.3): the editable version with live part stock, the
booking's `version` after the save (for the next `expected_version`) and
`created_new_version`.
EstimateEditRead.title: EstimateEditRead

EstimateLineRead.description:
A line as staff see it. `part` is the catalogue part with **live** stock, read when the
response is built (D40, EST-18): its stock fields are null for QC inspectors (spec 04 §B) and
`part` is null on `LABOUR` lines. On `PART` lines `description` is the catalogue name copied
when the line was saved, so a frozen version never changes when the catalogue does (EST-23).
EstimateLineRead.title: EstimateLineRead

EstimateLineWrite.description:
One line of `PUT …/estimate`: a catalogue `PART` or a free-text `LABOUR` line (D40).

`PART`: `part_id` (an active part of this shop, checked by the service), whole `quantity`
1-9 999, optional whole-rupee `unit_price` (defaults to the part's `unit_cost`); no
`description` (the server stores the catalogue name). `LABOUR`: `description` 1-255 (trimmed),
`quantity` 0.01-999.99, required `unit_price`; no `part_id`. Client totals are refused
(`extra_forbidden`). Every broken rule of the line is reported on its own field with the
spec 03 §2.3 code (`missing`, `not_allowed`, `not_whole_rupees`, `value_error`, …).
EstimateLineWrite.title: EstimateLineWrite

EstimateRead.description: One estimate version, staff view (`GET …/estimates`; spec 03 §3.4).
EstimateRead.title: EstimateRead

EstimateSummary.description:
`estimate_summary` of booking lists and details: staff get the latest version, customers
the latest `SENT`, `APPROVED` or `REJECTED` one (D39).
EstimateSummary.title: EstimateSummary

EstimateUpdate.description:
Body of `PUT /api/v1/shops/{shop_id}/bookings/{booking_id}/estimate` (O1).

`lines` is the full new list in display order (1-50). `inspection_notes` (≤ 4000, trimmed,
blank -> `None`) and `expected_version` are consumed by bookings: the notes are the
technician's, saved on the booking while `INSPECTING` (D40); the version check is D30's.
EstimateUpdate.title: EstimateUpdate

post.description: Returns the session token and the user (no memberships, D81) and sets the `bf_session` cookie. Call `GET /api/v1/me` next for memberships and capabilities. Five failed password checks per e-mail within 15 minutes block the account for the rest of the window (429), even with the right password (D69).

Expires the `bf_session` cookie. Idempotent and needs no authentication. The JWT is stateless, so a copied Bearer token stays valid until it expires (spec 04). When the cookie or Bearer token names an active user, the sign-out is recorded in the platform audit log (spec 19); a failure there never changes the 204.
Creates a user with no membership (D17) and logs it in: the token is returned in the body and set as the `bf_session` cookie. Create a shop next with `POST /api/v1/shops`.

Creates a `PENDING` booking (T01) and always logs the customer in: the response sets the `bf_session` cookie and carries `access_token`, `expires_in` and `account_created` (D32). Without a session, `customer.full_name`, `customer.email` and `customer.password` are required: a new e-mail creates the account, an existing one must come with its password (else 409 `EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED`, nothing created). With a session only `customer.phone` is used. 404 when the shop is unknown, unlisted or has no active service; 422 `INVALID_SLOT` off the grid; 409 `SLOT_FULL` when the slot is taken.
